articles.summary: At Winnebago Industries, our iconic brands spark a passion for adventure and wonder not only among our customers but within our own team. It’s this unique spirit that sets our people apart and drives team members like Kim Weckert to connect our customers with the outdoors.
articles.title: Trailblazing tech: How Winnebago’s Kim Weckert redefines the RV experience and connects the dots for customers

articles.summary: Where do you live? Are you in a state that gets chilly in the winter? Do temps dip down below zero mid-January leaving you dreaming of the boating season? Is your hometown known for the hot sun and warm temps? If you’ve answered yes to any of these questions, chances are, you will need to winterize your boat at some point throughout its lifetime.
articles.title: Grand Design can help you winter RV like a pro
